content.title: Tree Removal Permit
content.summary: The City of Woodinville requires a tree removal permit for the removal of significant trees to protect and maintain the city's tree canopy. Applications must include a site plan and supporting documents such as replanting plans or an arborist report.

steps.title: Complete Tree Removal Application
steps.text: Complete a Tree Removal Application including a site plan and necessary supporting documents such as replanting plans and/or an arborist report.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.text: Submit your completed application through the City's online Permit Portal or print and submit the Tree Removal Application Form (PDF).

required_documents.name: Site Plan
required_documents.description: A detailed plan of the site where tree removal is proposed.

required_documents.name: Replanting Plans
required_documents.description: Plans showing how trees will be replanted or replaced after removal.

required_documents.name: Arborist Report
required_documents.description: A professional report assessing the condition and necessity of tree removal.

form_fields.label: Site Plan
form_fields.description: A detailed map or drawing of the property showing the location of trees to be removed.
form_fields.why_needed: To assess the impact of tree removal on the property and surrounding area.

form_fields.label: Replanting Plans
form_fields.description: Documentation showing plans for replanting or replacing removed trees.
form_fields.why_needed: To ensure replacement of removed trees and maintain tree canopy.

form_fields.label: Arborist Report
form_fields.description: A report from a certified arborist evaluating the trees proposed for removal.
form_fields.why_needed: To provide expert assessment supporting the need for tree removal.

faqs.q: Is a permit required for all tree removals?
faqs.a: A tree removal permit is required for any proposal to remove significant trees, unless otherwise exempt in WMC 21.50.030.

faqs.q: How do I submit a tree removal application?
faqs.a: You can submit an application through the City's online Permit Portal or print and submit the Tree Removal Application Form (PDF).

faqs.q: Who do I contact for public tree maintenance or removal?
faqs.a: For public and private non-emergency tree issues, contact the Development Services Department at 425-489-2754.

faqs.q: What should I do in case of an emergency tree issue in the right-of-way?
faqs.a: During regular business hours, call the Public Works Department at 425-489-2700. After hours, dial 911.

faqs.q: Who handles tree issues near power lines?
faqs.a: Puget Sound Energy handles tree issues within 12 feet of power lines and can be reached at 1-888-225-5773.
